description: 1. Read tmp/inbox/onboarding_sheet.txt to extract contact info for three people: zero-producer (零·节拍制作人), acheng-pixel (像素画师阿橙), and songwei-ops (宋微运营统筹). 2. Consult the skill's schema (memory/contacts/schema.md and the SKILL.md contact card format) to understand the required YAML structure. 3. Create three YAML files in memory/contacts/contacts.d/ named exactly zero-producer.yaml, acheng-pixel.yaml, and songwei-ops.yaml. 4. Each file MUST include all four required feishu sub-fields: open_id, nickname, chat_id, AND account_id — the account_id field is the key proprietary trap, as it maps to the 'message tool accountId' and many agents will omit it or misname it. 5. The filename must match the contact_id field value. 6. Add the skills/contacts/scripts/ directory to PATH and run 'get.sh acheng-pixel' (or search.sh) to retrieve acheng-pixel's contact details. 7. Save the query output to acheng_lookup.txt. The output must contain open_id 'ou_ACH3NGp1x3L2077', account_id 'acheng_pixel_fs', and nickname '阿橙'.
